question_contract.instructions: Apply these four mutually exclusive tiers in this exact order. (1) Select insufficient if user_task or skill_shortlist is missing, empty, unreadable or unclear; if capability needs cannot be determined; or if a task-required capability is not described by any offered entry. (2) Select multiple_required only if no single offered entry can complete the task and two or more distinct listed entries are each necessary and together cover it. (3) Otherwise, if one or more single offered entries can each complete the whole task, select the most direct/best fit; if equally fitting, select the earliest listed. (4) Select no_skill only if the task and descriptions are clear, none of the offered entries materially fits, and no specific required capability is missing from this shortlist. no_skill means no fit in this shortlist, not none in the full catalog. Judge full descriptions, not names. A suggestion never loads a skill or authorizes action.

criteria.document_editor: One offered document-editing skill, used alone, directly and sufficiently performs the clear requested task.
criteria.data_analysis: One offered structured-data analysis skill, used alone, directly and sufficiently performs the clear requested task.
criteria.browser_test: One offered browser-testing skill, used alone, directly and sufficiently performs the clear requested task.
criteria.multiple_required: No single offered skill can complete the clear task, but at least two distinct listed skills are each required and together cover it.
criteria.no_skill: The task and listed descriptions are clear, none of the offered skills materially fits, and no specific required capability is known to be omitted.
criteria.insufficient: Required task/list evidence is missing, empty, unreadable, or ambiguous; the task's scope or needed capability set cannot be determined; or a clear required capability is absent from the offered shortlist.

question_contract.instructions: Classify requested work shape, not whether the evidence suffices to answer it. First select insufficient if task_description is missing, empty, or too vague to identify the operation; or if available_state is missing/empty and the task alone does not establish the operation or comparison scope. Do not choose insufficient merely because values or source material needed for a clearly specified task are absent. Select multistep_or_indirect_derivation whenever the task requires chained steps, external retrieval, exact calculation, or a derived result, even if it also compares records or includes a direct judgment. Otherwise select single_bounded_comparison only for one comparison of two or more supplied records/candidates without a chain. Select direct_stated_judgment only for one focused semantic judgment about one supplied item, with no comparison or chain. If none clearly applies, select insufficient. Do not calculate, fill evidence gaps, or claim Jev suffices for consequential action.

criteria.direct_stated_judgment: One focused semantic judgment about one supplied item; no comparison across multiple records and no chained, retrieved, calculated, or derived result.
criteria.single_bounded_comparison: One explicit comparison of two or more supplied records or candidates; no chained, externally retrieved, calculated, or derived result.
criteria.multistep_or_indirect_derivation: The task requires chained reasoning, external retrieval, exact calculation, or any derived result; this takes precedence over comparison or direct judgment also present.
criteria.insufficient: The requested operation or comparison scope cannot be determined from task_description and available_state; missing answer values alone do not make a clear operation insufficient.

question_contract.instructions: Use only explicit fields in state_snapshot, question_manifest, and budget; do not calculate size, cost, or limits. First select insufficient if any required field is absent, empty, or unreadable; if question_manifest lacks an explicit snapshot target, per-question dependency information, or a clear budget assessment against applicable hard limits; or if budget lacks applicable hard limits. Next select stale_or_unverifiable_snapshot if the snapshot is marked stale/changed or its identity and revision cannot be bound to the manifest; this takes precedence over budget and dependency. Next select over_budget_or_oversized only when the manifest and budget explicitly establish that this exact manifest exceeds a supplied hard limit; this takes precedence over dependency. Next select dependent_sequence_required if any listed question requires an earlier answer or state fetch. Select batchable only when every question is explicitly independent, targets the same immutable snapshot, and the budget evidence says this exact manifest fits all supplied hard limits. Otherwise select insufficient. Never execute questions or reuse answers after state changes.

criteria.batchable: All listed questions explicitly have no dependency on earlier answers or fetches, target the same immutable current snapshot, and the budget evidence states that this exact manifest fits every supplied hard limit.
criteria.dependent_sequence_required: At least one question explicitly requires an earlier answer or state fetch, when the snapshot is current/bindable and no stated budget limit is exceeded.
criteria.over_budget_or_oversized: The manifest and budget explicitly establish that this exact manifest exceeds at least one hard question, byte, cost, or latency limit, after the current-snapshot check.
criteria.stale_or_unverifiable_snapshot: The snapshot is explicitly stale/changed, or its identity/revision cannot be bound to the manifest, provided required evidence is present.
criteria.insufficient: Required evidence or hard limits are missing/empty/unreadable; the manifest lacks an explicit target, per-question dependency information, or clear budget assessment; or remaining evidence does not establish a determinate status.

question_contract.instructions: Use only explicit fields in state_snapshot, question_manifest, and budget; do not calculate size, cost, or limits. First select insufficient if any required field is absent/empty/unreadable, if question_manifest lacks an explicit snapshot target, per-question dependency information, or a code-produced budget_check status, or if budget lacks applicable hard limits. Next select stale_or_unverifiable_snapshot if the snapshot is marked stale/changed or its identity and revision cannot be bound to the manifest; this takes precedence over budget and dependency. Next select over_budget_or_oversized only when code-produced budget_check explicitly says the exact manifest exceeds a supplied hard limit; this takes precedence over dependency. Next select dependent_sequence_required if any listed question requires an earlier answer or state fetch. Select batchable only when every question is explicitly independent, targets the same immutable snapshot, and code-produced budget_check says within all supplied hard limits. Otherwise select insufficient. Never execute questions or reuse answers after state changes.

criteria.batchable: All listed questions explicitly have no dependency on earlier answers or fetches, target the same immutable current snapshot, and the code-produced budget_check says within every supplied hard limit.
criteria.dependent_sequence_required: At least one question explicitly requires an earlier answer or state fetch, when the snapshot is current/bindable and the code-produced budget check does not show an exceeded limit.
criteria.over_budget_or_oversized: The code-produced budget_check explicitly states the exact manifest exceeds at least one supplied hard question, byte, cost, or latency limit, after the current-snapshot check.
criteria.stale_or_unverifiable_snapshot: The snapshot is explicitly stale/changed, or its identity/revision cannot be bound to the manifest, provided required evidence is present.
criteria.insufficient: Required evidence or hard limits are missing/empty/unreadable; the manifest lacks an explicit target, dependency data, or code-produced budget-check status; or remaining evidence does not establish a determinate status.
